days.explanation:
DAY 15 — SIMPLE STUDENT NOTES

1. FIRST: RECALL WITHOUT NOTES
Spaced review due today from Days 1, 8, 12, 14 (+1/+3/+7/+14/+30). Include 1-2 weak items from any older day. Say the answers aloud BEFORE reading the model.

2. TODAY'S LEARNING
INTRODUCTION TO 10 USEFUL -IR VERBS (overview only, do not memorise all today): regular group finir, choisir, réussir, remplir, agir, réagir; irregular group partir, sortir, dormir, ouvrir. Today study ONLY finir and choisir. REGULAR -IR: Not every -IR verb is regular. Finir and choisir follow -is, -is, -it, -issons, -issez, -issent. Example: je finis / nous finissons. The extra -iss- appears with nous, vous, ils/elles. Compare with Week 1 -ER: nous parlons.

3. USEFUL WORDS AND SENTENCES
le devoir = homework / assignment
le travail = work
le livre = book (review)
le cours = class / lesson (review)
Je finis mon devoir. — I finish my homework.
Je choisis un livre. — I choose a book.

4. AVOID COMMON ERRORS
Keep the correct article, apostrophe, and verb ending. Do not add new grammar when a simpler sentence works.

5. MON HISTOIRE DU JOUR — COPY ONCE AND READ ALOUD
Le matin, je finis mon devoir dans ma petite chambre. Mon ami choisit un livre sur la table. Je choisis mon cahier et nous étudions le français ensemble. Ensuite, nous finissons notre travail. Le français est parfois difficile, mais nous aimons notre cours.

6. STUDY ROUTINE
Translate and speak without notes before checking answers. Correct your two weakest patterns. Review them again tomorrow. English-to-French tasks are in the sentences section.
fixed: Je finis mon devoir. — I finish my homework.
Je choisis un livre. — I choose a book.

days.explanation:
DAY 18 — SIMPLE STUDENT NOTES

1. FIRST: RECALL WITHOUT NOTES
Spaced review due today from Days 4, 11, 15, 17 (+1/+3/+7/+14/+30). Include 1-2 weak items from any older day. Say the answers aloud BEFORE reading the model.

2. TODAY'S LEARNING
STRESSED PRONOUNS (pronoms toniques): moi, toi, lui, elle, nous, vous, eux, elles. Use them after avec and pour: avec moi, pour toi, avec lui, avec elle, pour nous, avec eux. Short answers: Moi ! / Lui ! They are NOT the normal subject pronouns: je parle (not moi parle). No COD/COI lesson today.

3. USEFUL WORDS AND SENTENCES

Tu étudies avec moi ? — Are you studying with me?
Ce livre est pour toi. — This book is for you.

4. AVOID COMMON ERRORS
Keep the correct article, apostrophe, and verb ending. Do not add new grammar when a simpler sentence works.

5. MON HISTOIRE DU JOUR — COPY ONCE AND READ ALOUD
Aujourd'hui, mon ami étudie le français avec moi. Je choisis un livre pour lui et il trouve un cahier pour moi. Ma sœur travaille avec nous. Elle finit son travail, puis elle écoute la musique avec moi. Le soir, nous regardons la télévision ensemble.

6. STUDY ROUTINE
Translate and speak without notes before checking answers. Correct your two weakest patterns. Review them again tomorrow. English-to-French tasks are in the sentences section.

days.explanation:
DAY 19 — SIMPLE STUDENT NOTES

1. FIRST: RECALL WITHOUT NOTES
Spaced review due today from Days 5, 12, 16, 18 (+1/+3/+7/+14/+30). Include 1-2 weak items from any older day. Say the answers aloud BEFORE reading the model.

2. TODAY'S LEARNING
PARTIR and SORTIR do NOT follow finir's regular -iss- pattern. PARTIR: je pars, tu pars, il part, nous partons, vous partez, ils partent. SORTIR: je sors, tu sors, il sort, nous sortons, vous sortez, ils sortent. There is no -iss- here.

3. USEFUL WORDS AND SENTENCES
la gare = the train station
le parc = the park
la rue = the street
le matin = the morning (review)
le soir = the evening
Je pars le matin. — I leave in the morning.
Nous sortons avec nos amis. — We go out with our friends.

4. AVOID COMMON ERRORS
Do not apply finir's -iss- endings to every -IR verb. Always check which pattern today's verb uses.

5. MON HISTOIRE DU JOUR — COPY ONCE AND READ ALOUD
Le matin, je pars de la maison avec mon ami. Nous sortons dans la rue et nous allons dans le parc. Mon ami choisit un petit livre et je cherche mon cahier. Nous parlons français ensemble. Le soir, je sors avec ma sœur et nous parlons français.

6. STUDY ROUTINE
Translate and speak without notes before checking answers. Correct your two weakest patterns. Review them again tomorrow. English-to-French tasks are in the sentences section.
fixed: Je pars le matin. — I leave in the morning.
Nous sortons avec nos amis. — We go out with our friends.

days.explanation:
DAY 20 — SIMPLE STUDENT NOTES

1. FIRST: RECALL WITHOUT NOTES
Spaced review due today from Days 6, 13, 17, 19 (+1/+3/+7/+14/+30). Include 1-2 weak items from any older day. Say the answers aloud BEFORE reading the model.

2. TODAY'S LEARNING
DORMIR: je dors, tu dors, il dort, nous dormons, vous dormez, ils dorment. OUVRIR is unusual for an -IR infinitive: j'ouvre, tu ouvres, il ouvre, nous ouvrons, vous ouvrez, ils ouvrent; it sounds like the regular -ER present endings.

3. USEFUL WORDS AND SENTENCES
la nuit = the night
la porte = the door (review)
la fenêtre = the window (review)
le lit = the bed (review)
Je dors la nuit. — I sleep at night.
J’ouvre la porte. — I open the door.

4. AVOID COMMON ERRORS
Do not apply finir's -iss- endings to every -IR verb. Always check which pattern today's verb uses.

5. MON HISTOIRE DU JOUR — COPY ONCE AND READ ALOUD
Le soir, je finis mon devoir dans ma chambre. J'ouvre la fenêtre et je regarde la rue. Mon ami appelle au téléphone, mais je ne parle pas longtemps. Je regarde mon livre et je dors dans mon petit lit. Le matin, ma sœur ouvre la porte et elle part pour l'école.

6. STUDY ROUTINE
Translate and speak without notes before checking answers. Correct your two weakest patterns. Review them again tomorrow. English-to-French tasks are in the sentences section.

J’ouvre la porte. — I open the door.

DAY 21 — SIMPLE STUDENT NOTES

1. FIRST: RECALL WITHOUT NOTES
Spaced review due today from Days 7, 14, 18, 20 (+1/+3/+7/+14/+30). Include 1-2 weak items from any older day. Say the answers aloud BEFORE reading the model.

2. TODAY'S LEARNING
ASK BASIC QUESTIONS: (1) Raise your voice: Tu parles français ? (2) Add est-ce que: Est-ce que tu parles français ? (3) Use useful words with familiar verbs: Tu habites où ? Tu pars quand ? Comment tu étudies ? Pourquoi est-ce que tu étudies ? Combien de livres tu choisis ? Avoid formal inversion for now. Review the entire week's verbs and old negation.

3. USEFUL WORDS AND SENTENCES

Tu habites où ? — Where do you live?
Est-ce que tu finis ton devoir ? — Do you finish your homework?

4. AVOID COMMON ERRORS
Keep the correct article, apostrophe, and verb ending. Do not add new grammar when a simpler sentence works.

5. MON HISTOIRE DU JOUR — COPY ONCE AND READ ALOUD
Aujourd'hui, j'étudie le français avec mon ami. Il demande : « Tu finis ton devoir ? » Je finis mon devoir et je demande : « Tu sors ce soir ? » Mon ami ne sort pas ce soir. Nous choisissons un livre et nous parlons français ensemble.

6. STUDY ROUTINE
Translate and speak without notes before checking answers. Correct your two weakest patterns. Review them again tomorrow. English-to-French tasks are in the sentences section.
fixed: Tu habites où ? — Where do you live?
